parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by ‘unipolar depression’.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe two drug treatments for depression.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Explain one similarity and one difference between drug treatments for depression and
cognitive restructuring treatment for depression (Beck, 1979).

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the causes of impulse control disorders and non-substance addictive disorder.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate the causes of impulse control disorders and non-substance addictive disorder,
including a discussion of reductionism. 
Psychology and consumer behaviour

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by the term ‘personal space’.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe two findings of the study by Milgram et al. (1986) on defending a place in a queue.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain one strength and one weakness of the study by Milgram et al. (1986).

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about lighting, colour and smell in the physical
environment.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about lighting, colour, and smell in the physical
environment, including a discussion of ecological validity. 
Psychology and health

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by a ‘Type II error’ in relation to practitioner diagnosis.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Describe the procedure used in the study by McKinstry and Wang (1991) on the style of
doctors’ clothing.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain two strengths of the study by McKinstry and Wang (1991).

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe what psychologists have discovered about causes of stress.

parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about causes of stress, including a discussion
on reliability.

parts.text: Explain one strength and one weakness of the study by Gold et al. (1992).
